description: This file defines the UserPreference class, which manages user preferences for the SuiteCRM application, including retrieving, setting, loading, saving, and resetting preferences stored in the database, with support for default values and session management.

classes.name: UserPreference
classes.description: Class handling user preferences in SuiteCRM, providing methods to retrieve, modify, load, save, and reset preferences, interacting with the database and session storage.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializing the UserPreference object with an optional User focus.

methods.name: getPreference
methods.description: Retrieve a preference value by name and category, with lazy loading from the database if necessary, or default values.

methods.name: getDefaultPreference
methods.description: Retrieve default system-wide preference by name, typically from the global configuration.

methods.name: setPreference
methods.description: Set a preference value for the user, updating session and marking for database persistence.

methods.name: loadPreferences
methods.description: Load user preferences for a given category from the database into session.

methods.name: reloadPreferences
methods.description: Force reload of preferences from the database into session.

methods.name: getUserDateTimePreferences
methods.description: Retrieve user's date and time format preferences along with timezone information.

methods.name: savePreferencesToDB
methods.description: Persist all modified preferences from session into the database.

methods.name: resetPreferences
methods.description: Reset preferences for the user, optionally within a specific category, clearing sessions and database entries.

methods.name: updateAllUserPrefs
methods.description: Admin-only static method to update or unset a specific user preference across all users in the database.
